paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Indonesia
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the counts of polarity scores for Indonesia based on an analysis of vaccine-related sentiments. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2, displaying a visible range from -1.0 to 0.6. The y-axis, labeled "Counts", also employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35000, with tick marks consistently placed at intervals of 5000. The data is represented by a single solid blue line with circular markers. The line begins at a polarity score of roughly -1.1 with a count near 0, maintaining this near-zero level until approximately -0.7. It then exhibits a minor rise to about 3400 at x = -0.55, dips slightly to roughly 1900 at x = -0.35, and subsequently ascends rapidly. The most prominent feature of the plot is a sharp, distinct peak at x = 0.0, reaching exactly 35000 counts. Following this maximum, the line drops steeply to roughly 12000 at x = 0.1, rises to a secondary peak near 17500 at x = 0.2, and declines sharply again, falling to near 400 at x = 0.35. A final, smaller peak occurs around x = 0.45 with approximately 6000 counts before the line terminates at a polarity score of roughly 0.55 with a count close to 200.
